description: Create a saved QR look (no qr_style_id: POST /qr-styles), change one (PUT /qr-styles/:id) or delete one (delete true). style is a flat JSON object of the QR options; a logo is a storage path in your org's logo folder (<org id>/qr/<file>), never a data: URL. is_default true makes it the org default (the previous default is cleared). Write tier.
name: tascan_save_qr_style
